title: Naked Woman Breaks Into Neighbor’s Home While Child Is Left Alone (Police Bodycam)
description:
On May 1st, 2024. Police responded to a situation involving a naked woman who broke into a strangers home while leaving her kid unsupervised. This is body-cam footage of the events.
